description_en: Queries the operations and maintenance (O&M) notices published by a service provider
description_zh: 调用ListOpsNotices查询服务商发布过的运维公告
kebab_example: aliyun computenestsupplier list-ops-notices --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --max-results 20 --next-token AAAAAfu+XtuBE55iRLHEYYuojI4= --filter '[{"Value":["1"],"Name":"ServiceId"}]' --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListOpsNotices

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页行数。其中最大值为100行，默认值为20行
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The query token. Set the value to the NextToken value returned in the last API call
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值
parameters.name: next_token

element_fields.help_en:
The filter name. Valid values:

Type: The notice type.

ServiceId: The service ID.

ServiceName: The service name. Fuzzy search is supported. The format for a fuzzy search is \xxx.

Category: The notice category.

Severity: The severity level.

NoticeId: The O\&M notice ID
element_fields.help_zh:
过滤器名称。可选值：

Type：公告类型。

ServiceId：服务ID。

ServiceName：服务名称，支持模糊查询。模糊查询的格式为：\xxx\。

Category：公告类别。

Severity：告警等级。

NoticeId：运维公告ID
element_fields.name: name
